newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank in $103 mln loan for Malaysian ships.
newsitem.headline: China bank in $103 mln loan for Malaysian ships.

text.p: The Export and Import Bank of China has offered guarantees for a $103 million syndicated loan to build and export six ships to Malaysia, Xinhua news agency said on Friday.

A syndicate of 14 banks headed by Japan's Sumitomo Bank Ltd and Sanwa Bank had arranged the loan to help finance a $184 million deal between China Shipbuilding Trading Co and Malaysian shippers for six cargo vessels, Xinhua said.

Under the deal, signed in February, China Shipbuilding and the Jiangnan, Hudong and Dalian shipyards are to build four bulk carriers and two chemical products carriers weighing a total of 329,000 deadweight tonnes, Xinhua said.
The ships are to be delivered in 1998 and 1999 to Malaysia Global Maritime Ventures Co and Wawassan Shipping Co.

China Eximbank would continue to consolidate cooperation with the international financial community to try to boost China's exports of ships, Xinhua quoted bank board chairman Tong Zhiguang as saying.
